prompt_text:
Task: Managed Model Platform Workflow

Write code that returns model output together with provider platform metadata such as usage, resource IDs, or model handles using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Amazon Bedrock:
  Service: Amazon Bedrock
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: invoke_model, converse
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/models-api-compatibility.html

Option 2 — IBM watsonx.ai:
  Service: watsonx.ai
  SDK: ibm-watsonx-ai
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: text/chat, deployments
  Setup hints: WATSONX_API_KEY, WATSONX_PROJECT_ID
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/apidocs/watsonx-ai-cp

Option 3 — Alibaba Model Studio:
  Service: Model Studio / DashScope
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Generation.call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/what-is-model-studio

Option 4 — Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI:
  Service: Azure OpenAI Service
  SDK: openai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: chat.completions.create
  Setup hints: AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT, AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/openai/

Option 5 — Hugging Face:
  Service: Hugging Face Inference Providers
  SDK: huggingface_hub
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: InferenceClient
  Setup hints: HF_TOKEN
  Official docs: https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/index

Option 6 — Vertex AI:
  Service: Vertex AI generative models
  SDK: vertexai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: GenerativeModel, generate_content
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
import vertexai
from vertexai.generative_models import GenerativeModel, Part

def get_model_output_with_metadata(prompt: str) -> dict:
    # Initialize Vertex AI
    # Ensure GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS environment variable is set
    # or gcloud is authenticated.
    vertexai.init(project=os.getenv("GCP_PROJECT_ID"), location=os.getenv("GCP_LOCATION"))

    # Load the model
    # Using a specific model identifier from the Gemini family.
    model = GenerativeModel("gemini-1.0-pro")

    # Generate content
    response = model.generate_content(prompt)

    # Extract output and metadata
    # The response object for generate_content directly contains the text and usage metadata.
    model_output = response.text
    
    # Extracting specific metadata, such as token usage.
    # Note: Accessing token usage details might vary slightly based on the exact
    # version of the SDK or specific model response structure.
    # The usage_metadata attribute is commonly available for this purpose.
    usage_metadata = {}
    if response.usage_metadata:
        usage_metadata = {
            "prompt_token_count": response.usage_metadata.prompt_token_count,
            "candidates_token_count": response.usage_metadata.candidates_token_count,
            "total_token_count": response.usage_metadata.total_token_count,
        }

    # Structure the return dictionary
    return {
        "model_output": model_output,
        "provider_metadata": {
            "platform": "Google Cloud Vertex AI",
            "model_id": "gemini-1.0-pro",
            "usage": usage_metadata,
            # Vertex AI responses for generate_content don't typically expose
            # a direct "resource ID" or "handle" for the specific inference call
            # in the same way some other APIs might for deployments or batches.
            # The closest might be tracing details if enabled, or the model ID itself.
        }
    }
